verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP server exposes email operations (list and get threads, send and draft, label changes, bulk delete and archive), so an agent can drive the mailbox without the UI. However, authentication requires manually copying a browser session cookie into the Authorization header, OAuth is only 'coming soon', and nothing documents a headless or CI run mode. The pnpm test and eval scripts are developer tooling for the product itself, not a way to automate it. Missing for 10: a documented headless/CLI mode, CI-friendly non-interactive auth (API keys or service tokens), CI usage docs or examples, and hands-on corroboration.
